items.title: Avery Dennison® Unveils PrismaPro: Breaking the Compromise Between Custom Color and Ultimate Protection

items.title: Avery Dennison® Helps Drive Awareness With Skin Cancer Foundation’s Mobile Screening
items.summary: May is Skin Cancer Awareness Month and skin cancer is America’s most common form of the disease with more than five million cases diagnosed in the United States each year. Fortunately, it’s also one of the most preventable cancers. That’s why Avery Dennison® (NYSE:AVY) has partnered with The Skin Cancer Foundation to encourage people to check their skin for warning signs and reduce long-term exposure to the sun’s harmful rays.

items.title: Avery Dennison unveils industry-first RFID label recognized by APR for compatibility with PET recycling stream
items.summary: Avery Dennison has announced a breakthrough in recyclable labeling: The first RFID label to receive APR Design® for Recyclability (DfR) recognition from the Association of Plastic Recyclers (APR). This marks an industry first for an RFID label, validating its compatibility with North America's PET recycling stream.
